_note: 60 Seconds! / 60 Parsecs! style turn-based flight survival & engineering logbook (no countdown timer on questions). 24 conditional nodes: 4 gates x 3 missions x 2 states (critical / nominal).

critical.title: Flight Log #1 · Max-Q Structural Vibration Alert!
critical.scenario_context: As your lunar spacecraft climbs through Max-Q, telemetry warns that payload mass or budget reserve is right on the structural limit of the launch vehicle. How do you use your packed resources?

options.label: Authorize UFE Reserve for Upper-Stage Thrust Trim (-5% UFE)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Spends 5% UFE vault reserve to add +45 kg effective propellant margin.

options.label: Jettison Non-Essential Structural Ballast (-45 kg dry mass)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Lightens spacecraft by 45 kg to clear the fairing/mass threshold safely.

options.label: Hold Nominal Throttle & Save UFE Vault
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Preserves all UFE funds for later crises, but leaves zero structural margin.

nominal.title: Flight Log #1 · Clean Tower Clearance & Stage Separation!
nominal.scenario_context: Your launch vehicle cleared Max-Q with comfortable mass and UFE budget margins. The upper stage is ready for Translunar Injection (TLI). Which logbook order do you issue?

options.label: Bank Propellant Margin (+30 kg fuel reserve)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Optimizes upper-stage cutoff to save +30 kg propellant for orbital maneuvers.

options.label: Power Early Payload Calibration (+5 Science, -3% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses 3% battery reserve during coast to pre-calibrate lunar spectrometers.

options.label: Freeze UFE Contingency Vault (+3% UFE buffer)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Locks unused pad integration funds into the emergency UFE vault.

critical.title: Flight Log #1 (Artemis) · Max-Q Structural Vibration Alert!
critical.scenario_context: As your lunar spacecraft climbs through Max-Q, telemetry warns that wet mass or budget reserve is right on the structural limit of the launch vehicle. How do you respond using your packed resources?

options.label: Authorize UFE Reserve for Upper-Stage Thrust Trim (-5% UFE)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Spends 5% UFE vault reserve to add +45 kg effective propellant margin.

options.label: Jettison Non-Essential Adapter Ballast (-45 kg dry mass)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Lightens spacecraft by 45 kg to help clear launch mass limits.

options.label: Hold Nominal Throttle & Save UFE Vault
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Preserves all UFE funds for cislunar storms, risking launch margin.

nominal.title: Flight Log #1 (Artemis) · Clean Liftoff & Translunar Injection!
nominal.scenario_context: Your rocket cleared the tower with comfortable mass and UFE margins. Before entering cislunar coast, how should the crew allocate the upper-stage surplus?

options.label: Bank Propellant Margin (+30 kg fuel reserve)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Saves +30 kg of propellant for lunar Free-Return trim burns.

options.label: Pre-Warm UV-Vis Spectrometer (+5 Science, -3% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Boosts lunar spectral science (+5) using 3% battery reserve.

options.label: Reallocate Ground Savings to UFE Vault (+3% UFE)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Strengthens emergency UFE reserve (+3%) for the rest of the voyage.

critical.title: Flight Log #1 (Asteroid) · Rideshare / Fairing Load Warning!
critical.scenario_context: During hyperbolic escape burn toward the near-Earth asteroid, payload mass and integration cost are straining the launch adapter limits. Choose your survival action:

options.label: Eject Heavy Separation Ring Early (-50 kg dry mass)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Drops 50 kg of adapter mass to ease launcher and Delta-v constraints.

options.label: Fund Star-48 Kick-Stage Impulse (-5% UFE, +55 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses 5% UFE reserve to boost interplanetary propellant margin.

options.label: Power Down Secondary Heater (+4% Battery, -4 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Conserves electrical reserve at a small cost to initial science.

nominal.title: Flight Log #1 (Asteroid) · Flawless Earth Escape Trajectory!
nominal.scenario_context: Your spacecraft leaves Earth's gravity well on target for the asteroid rendezvous with healthy mass and UFE reserves. How do you use the clean departure?

options.label: Preserve Braking Propellant (+35 kg propellant)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Saves extra hydrazine/bipropellant for asteroid proximity operations.

options.label: Run Deep-Space FTIR Star Calibration (+5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Improves mineralogical calibration before arriving at the asteroid.

options.label: Store Unused Launch Allowance (+4% UFE)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Adds +4% to UFE reserve for boulder hazard operations.

critical.title: Flight Log #1 (Mars MSR) · Heavy Aeroshell & Nunn-McCurdy Alert!
critical.scenario_context: Your Mars bound stack (Orbiter + Sample Return Aeroshell) is pushing the rocket fairing and budget cap to the absolute limit during ascent. What do you sacrifice or deploy?

options.label: Jettison Cruise Stage Trim Weights (-60 kg dry mass)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Cuts 60 kg from dry mass to prevent a launch manifest overload.

options.label: Commit 6% UFE for Upper-Stage Injection Boost (+65 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Spends 6% UFE to secure Trans-Mars Injection propellant margin.

options.label: Defer Non-Critical Ground Ops (-$35M cost, -5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Reduces total mission cost by $35M USD to help avoid a budget breach.

nominal.title: Flight Log #1 (Mars MSR) · Textbook Trans-Mars Injection!
nominal.scenario_context: With over 52% propellant mass fraction properly matched to your heavy launcher, the spacecraft is cruising toward Mars. Choose your logbook priority:

options.label: Reserve Extra Aerobraking Propellant (+45 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Buffers propellant tank for Mars Orbit Insertion (MOI).

options.label: Execute Cruise Optical Alignment (+6 Science, -3% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Sharpens HiRISE and CRISM alignment before Mars arrival.

options.label: Lock Launch Surplus into Mars UFE Vault (+4% UFE)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Increases UFE reserve (+4%) ahead of Martian dust season.

critical.title: Flight Log #2 · Thruster Torque & 1.5x Fuel Burn Warning!
critical.scenario_context: During trajectory correction, an off-center Center of Gravity (or tight Delta-v margin) is forcing the attitude thrusters to burn 1.5x propellant! What do you use from your spacecraft kit?

options.label: Spin Up Electric Reaction Wheels to Re-Center CG (-7% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses electrical power to cancel parasitic torque and restore 1.0x fuel burn!

options.label: Pump Reserve Propellant Across Trim Tanks (-4% UFE, +50 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Balances CG and adds +50 kg usable propellant using ground UFE support.

options.label: Force Raw Thruster Burn Without Re-Trimming
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Saves battery and UFE, but keeps the 1.5x fuel burn penalty active.

nominal.title: Flight Log #2 · Balanced CG & On-Target Trajectory Burn!
nominal.scenario_context: Your Center of Gravity is dead-center within tolerance, so the main engine burns at 1.0x nominal efficiency. How do you shape the orbital capture maneuver?

options.label: Drop Into Low Mapping Orbit (+6 Science, -20 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses spare Delta-v to reach a closer, higher-resolution science orbit.

options.label: Execute Minimum-Energy Capture (+35 kg fuel, +3% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Conserves propellant and battery charge for the upcoming environment event.

options.label: Desaturate Momentum Wheels (+0.03 Spectral F1)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Stabilizes platform jitter so spectral instruments capture sharper peaks.

critical.title: Flight Log #2 (Artemis) · Lunar Perilune Wobble & 1.5x Fuel Burn!
critical.scenario_context: Approaching the Moon, an unbalanced Center of Gravity (or tight Hydrazine Delta-v) is causing attitude wobble and burning 1.5x fuel. How does the crew stabilize Orion/bus?

options.label: Overdrive Reaction Wheels to Balance CG (-7% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Restores 1.0x nominal fuel burn at the cost of 7% battery reserve.

options.label: Switch to Lunar Free-Return Gravity Assist (-4% UFE, +55 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses lunar gravity and ground UFE replanning to recover Delta-v margin.

options.label: Hold Direct Burn Without Re-Trim
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Saves battery for solar storms, but risks running dry on propellant.

nominal.title: Flight Log #2 (Artemis) · Smooth Lunar Flyby & CG Equilibrium!
nominal.scenario_context: Because your CG was balanced inside the 0.25 m lunar tolerance, the engine burn is crisp and efficient. Choose your perilune maneuver:

options.label: Skim South Pole Shackleton Crater (+6 Science, -20 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Trades a small amount of spare fuel for high-value polar ice data.

options.label: Bank Propellant & Charge Batteries (+35 kg fuel, +4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Maximizes survival reserves before crossing the radiation belt.

options.label: Fine-Tune Star Tracker Pointing (+0.4 dB Link Margin)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses stable CG to pre-align the high-gain dish toward Earth.

critical.title: Flight Log #2 (Asteroid) · Off-Axis Braking Burn Near Bennu!
critical.scenario_context: As you decelerate to match the asteroid's orbit, unbalanced instrument mass (or low Delta-v margin) is causing a 1.5x fuel burn penalty. Choose your corrective action:

options.label: Gimbal Thruster & Reaction Wheels (-6% Battery, Restores 1.0x Burn)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Re-aligns thrust vector through the true CG using 6% battery.

options.label: Jettison Sample Cover & Trim Mass (-40 kg dry, +40 kg fuel eq.)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Restores CG balance and stretches remaining Delta-v for orbital capture.

options.label: Accept Fast Flyby Instead of Full Braking (-8 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Reduces science collection time, but saves battery and UFE.

nominal.title: Flight Log #2 (Asteroid) · Precision Microgravity Braking!
nominal.scenario_context: Your spacecraft CG is balanced within 0.15 m, matching the asteroid's spin axis with plenty of propellant to spare. What is your next logbook command?

options.label: Descend to 1 km Survey Orbit (+7 Science, -20 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Captures razor-sharp FTIR mineral maps using spare propellant.

options.label: Save Propellant for Touch-and-Go Escape (+40 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Keeps extra tank pressure to escape asteroid dust plumes.

options.label: Top Up Battery & Autonomy Computers (+5% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Prepares the electrical bus for close-approach hazards.

critical.title: Flight Log #2 (Mars MSR) · Mars Orbit Insertion & CG Torque Crisis!
critical.scenario_context: Approaching Mars, your 0.08 m CG tolerance is violated (or Delta-v is critically short), threatening to make the spacecraft skip off the Martian atmosphere! How do you intervene?

options.label: Execute Multi-Pass Aerobraking & Wheel Re-Trim (-7% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses upper Martian atmosphere and reaction wheels to restore 1.0x burn.

options.label: Activate Emergency MAV Crossfeed Valve (-5% UFE, +70 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Rebalances CG and injects +70 kg effective propellant margin.

options.label: Jettison Secondary Cruise Shield (-55 kg dry mass)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Reduces spacecraft dry mass so main engine capture can succeed.

nominal.title: Flight Log #2 (Mars MSR) · Perfect Mars Orbit Insertion Burn!
nominal.scenario_context: Even under the strict 0.08 m Mars CG tolerance, your mass balance held firm during the main engine burn. Select your orbital trim strategy:

options.label: Lock Into Low Sun-Synchronous Orbit (+8 Science, -25 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Gives HiRISE and CRISM maximum resolution over Jezero Crater.

options.label: Bank Propellant for Earth Return (+50 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Secures extra Delta-v margin for the return journey.

options.label: Condition Batteries Before Surface Ops (+6% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Boosts battery reserve (+6%) ahead of Martian dust storms.

critical.title: Flight Log #3 · Deep-Space Hazard & Low Reserve Emergency!
critical.scenario_context: A severe space environment event strikes while your survival reserves (Battery, Visual Autonomy, or UFE) are dangerously low! Check your packed subsystems and choose:

options.label: Deploy UFE Ground Recovery & Auxiliary Cells (-5% UFE, +12% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses UFE vault funds to restore battery reserve and enable Visual Autonomy.

options.label: Shut Down Secondary Heaters to Charge Bus (+15% Battery, -6 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Sacrifices a small slice of science to keep battery above Safe Mode limits.

options.label: Enter Passive Safe Mode & Ride Out the Storm
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Protects the spacecraft bus, but reduces downlink efficiency to 0.85.

nominal.title: Flight Log #3 · Hazard Weathered with Strong Packed Reserves!
nominal.scenario_context: When the space environment anomaly hit, your packed thermal shield, power source, autonomy, and UFE reserves absorbed the impact cleanly! How do you exploit this window?

options.label: Record High-Energy Event Spectra (+8 Science, -4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Turns the hazard into bonus scientific discovery using spare battery.

options.label: Channel Surplus Watts to DSN Amplifier (+0.6 dB Link Margin)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Pre-charges the RF transmitter for the final DSN downlink stage.

options.label: Hold All Power & UFE Reserves Intact (+5% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Guarantees maximum safety margin through Earth reentry.

critical.title: Flight Log #3 (Artemis) · Cislunar Solar Particle Storm (Kp=7)!
critical.scenario_context: A coronal mass ejection slams into cislunar space! Your battery reserve (<15%) or thermal protection is under severe stress before Earth reentry at 40,000 km/h.

options.label: Reroute Fuel Cell & UFE Backup (-5% UFE, +12% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Boosts battery reserve (+12%) so Orion avoids dropping into Safe Mode.

options.label: Hibernate Lunar Cameras to Save Core Bus (+15% Battery, -6 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Protects life-critical reentry avionics by pausing secondary imaging.

options.label: Ride Out Storm in Passive Safe Mode
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Saves UFE, but storm noise degrades downlink efficiency (0.85).

nominal.title: Flight Log #3 (Artemis) · Solar Storm Deflected & Heat Shield Ready!
nominal.scenario_context: Your H2 fuel cells / batteries (>=15% reserve) and installed heat shield handled the cislunar solar storm without losing lock. What is your crew order?

options.label: Measure Balmer H-alpha Solar Flare Lines (+8 Science, -4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Captures rare solar flare UV-Vis spectra for bonus science points.

options.label: Pre-Boost S-Band Downlink Amplifier (+4.6 dB Link Margin)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses spare watts to guarantee a clean DSN carrier lock.

options.label: Top Up Reentry Battery Bank (+5% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Keeps maximum electrical margin for 40,000 km/h atmospheric entry.

critical.title: Flight Log #3 (Asteroid) · Ejecta Dust Cloud & Boulder Hazard!
critical.scenario_context: As you descend toward the asteroid surface, a cloud of gravel and dust blinds the star trackers! Without Visual Autonomy or >=15% UFE reserve, collision risk is high.

options.label: Upload Emergency NFT Visual Autonomy Patch (+6% UFE, Enables Autonomy)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses ground UFE tasking to activate onboard optical navigation and +8% UFE margin.

options.label: Wave-Off & Re-Approach Using Optical Backup (-25 kg fuel, Enables Autonomy)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Spends 25 kg of propellant to clear the dust cloud and lock visual tracking.

options.label: Stay at High Standoff Altitude (-8 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Avoids boulder collision, but reduces close-up mineral sampling.

nominal.title: Flight Log #3 (Asteroid) · Autonomous Touch-and-Go Between Boulders!
nominal.scenario_context: Your packed Visual Autonomy (Natural Feature Tracking) and >=15% UFE reserve guided the probe safely past Mount Doom boulder on the asteroid! How do you proceed?

options.label: Collect Bonus Regolith FTIR Spectra (+9 Science, -3% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Captures hydrated phyllosilicate and carbonyl bands at point-blank range.

options.label: Route Surplus Power to X-Band HGA (+4.5 dB Link Margin)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Ensures all 160 Gbit of asteroid data will clear the DSN link.

options.label: Pulse Nitrogen Thrusters to Dust Off Arrays (+5% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Restores +5% battery reserve after leaving the dust plume.

critical.title: Flight Log #3 (Mars MSR) · Global Dust Storm & Sample Arm Jam!
critical.scenario_context: A Martian dust storm cuts sunlight to 43% while the sample transfer arm jams! Without a Pu-238 RTG (or >=25% battery) and >=20% UFE reserve, half the sample tubes are at risk.

options.label: Authorize UFE Vibro-Percussion & H2 Reserve (+8% UFE, +12% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Frees the jammed sample arm and restores power/UFE above the 20%/25% threshold!

options.label: Engage Seebeck Thermal Shunt & Shed Heaters (+15% Battery, -6 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Redirects thermal bus power to load all sample tubes before launch window closes.

options.label: Launch Mars Ascent Vehicle Immediately With Current Tubes
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Guarantees orbital rendezvous, but leaves uncollected tubes on the surface.

nominal.title: Flight Log #3 (Mars MSR) · Pu-238 RTG Powers Through the Dust Storm!
nominal.scenario_context: While dust darkened the Martian sky, your nuclear RTG / high battery reserve and >=20% UFE kept the sample arm warm and sealed every titanium tube in the containment capsule!

options.label: Run Extra Amide-I Bio-Signature Scan (+9 Science, -4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Uses spare RTG/battery margin to verify biosignatures in the sealed tubes.

options.label: Power MRO 3 m High-Gain Relay (+4.6 dB Link Margin)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Locks the Mars-to-Earth X-band relay well above the +3.0 dB DSN threshold.

options.label: Store Thermal & Battery Reserves for Earth Return (+6% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Keeps maximum safety margin for Earth Return Orbiter capture.

critical.title: Flight Log #4 · Weak DSN Carrier Lock & 160 Gbit Buffer Full!
critical.scenario_context: Solar interference and high path loss have dropped your Deep Space Network link margin below +3.0 dB (or degraded packet efficiency) while 160 Gbit of science waits in memory!
critical.nasa_concept_badge: DSN +3.0 dB Link Budget & DTMF Lock

options.label: Compress & Prioritize High-F1 Spectral Packets (-4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Restores +3.4 dB link margin and 0.96 downlink efficiency for core science!

options.label: Divert Instrument Watts to 3 m Dish Amplifier (-5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Boosts antenna power to achieve +3.8 dB margin and 1.0 downlink efficiency.

options.label: Switch to 0.5 Mbps Safe Carrier Trickle
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Secures +3.2 dB carrier lock, but only downlinks 78% of the buffer.

nominal.title: Flight Log #4 · 3 m High-Gain Antenna Locked on Goldstone/Madrid DSN!
nominal.scenario_context: Your link margin is well above +3.0 dB and the DTMF telemetry channel is crystal clear. How do you schedule the final 160 Gbit science dump to Earth?

options.label: Transmit Full 160 Gbit Archive at 6.0 Mbps (+5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Delivers 100% downlink efficiency and bonus calibrated spectra to Earth.

options.label: Run Live NIST Ground Cross-Calibration (+0.04 Spectral F1)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Sharpens final spectral F1 score using Goldstone reference standards.

options.label: Balanced 4.5 Mbps Downlink (+3% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Completes 100% data transfer while conserving onboard battery.

critical.title: Flight Log #4 (Artemis) · Lunar Occultation & Weak DSN Lock!
critical.scenario_context: Before lunar occultation blocks Earth line-of-sight, your S-band link margin (< +3.0 dB) is struggling to empty the 160 Gbit solid-state recorder! Choose your comms protocol:

options.label: Compress & Prioritize Balmer / Polar NDVI Cubes (-4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Recovers +3.4 dB link margin and 0.96 downlink efficiency.

options.label: Route Auxiliary Bus Watts to High-Gain Dish (-5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Pushes link margin to +3.8 dB with 1.0 downlink efficiency.

options.label: Step Down to 1.0 Mbps Robust Coding
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Locks carrier at +3.2 dB, transmitting 78% of recorded packets.

nominal.title: Flight Log #4 (Artemis) · Clean Cislunar Downlink & Splashdown Prep!
nominal.scenario_context: With >= +3.0 dB link margin locked onto Madrid DSN and the Orion heat shield ready, the 160 Gbit recorder is streaming smoothly. Select your final action:

options.label: Downlink Full Polar Ice & Radiation Archive (+5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Achieves 100% downlink efficiency and maximizes lunar science.

options.label: Verify Wien Peak & Balmer Lines With Ground Lab (+0.04 F1)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Boosts spectral calibration F1 score before splashdown.

options.label: Standard Telemetry Dump & Save Reentry Power (+3% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Secures 100% downlink while keeping extra battery for splashdown.

critical.title: Flight Log #4 (Asteroid) · Deep-Space Signal Delay & DTMF Jitter!
critical.scenario_context: Millions of kilometers from Earth, high free-space path loss has pushed your DSN link margin below +3.0 dB while 160 Gbit of FTIR asteroid maps sit in memory!

options.label: Lossless-Compress FTIR Si-O & O-H Spectra (-4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Restores +3.5 dB link margin and 0.96 downlink efficiency.

options.label: Power Down Context Camera to Boost Travelling-Wave Tube (-5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Focuses all bus watts into the dish for +3.9 dB margin and 1.0 efficiency.

options.label: Transmit Priority Mineral Packets at 0.8 Mbps
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Guarantees +3.2 dB carrier lock, delivering 78% of the dataset.

nominal.title: Flight Log #4 (Asteroid) · Goldstone 70 m Dish Locked at +4.2 dB!
nominal.scenario_context: Your DTMF carrier key unlocked the deep-space transponder and the 3 m dish holds a rock-solid >= +3.0 dB link to Goldstone. How do you finalize the mission log?

options.label: Dump Full 3D Bennu Mineral & Boulder Map (+6 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Completes 100% downlink and awards bonus asteroid mapping science.

options.label: Match FTIR Silicate Peaks Against NIST Library (+0.04 F1)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Increases final spectral calibration F1 score.

options.label: Nominal Downlink & Preserve Extended-Mission Fuel (+25 kg fuel)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Saves propellant for an extended asteroid tour.

critical.title: Flight Log #4 (Mars MSR) · Solar Conjunction Approaching & Buffer Full!
critical.scenario_context: Mars is about to pass behind the Sun (Solar Conjunction blackout: 0 Mbps for 2 weeks) with 4–25 min one-way light delay and your DSN link margin is under +3.0 dB! Act now:

options.label: Burst-Transmit Amide-I Bio-Spectra & Sample Manifest (-5% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Beats Solar Conjunction with +3.5 dB margin and 0.96 downlink efficiency!

options.label: Shut Down SHARAD Radar to Max Out 3 m X-Band Dish (-5 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Pushes DSN link to +3.9 dB and empties 100% of the 160 Gbit recorder.

options.label: Store Half in Solid-State Memory Until Post-Conjunction
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Secures +3.2 dB lock now, but leaves downlink efficiency at 0.78.

nominal.title: Flight Log #4 (Mars MSR) · 6.0 Mbps X-Band Lock Before Conjunction!
nominal.scenario_context: Your 3 m High-Gain Antenna is locked onto Canberra/Goldstone DSN at >= +3.0 dB, emptying the 160 Gbit solid-state recorder ahead of Solar Conjunction!

options.label: Stream Full HiRISE, CRISM & Sample Bio-Archive (+7 Science)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Empties 100% of the 160 Gbit buffer with maximum scientific return.

options.label: Deconvolve Amide-I Sub-Bands With JPL Ground Reference (+0.04 F1)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Boosts final biosignature F1 calibration accuracy.

options.label: Complete Downlink & Reserve Reentry Capsule Power (+4% Battery)
options.engineering_tradeoff_hint: Delivers 100% of data while fortifying Earth Return capsule reserves.
